supporting_observations.claim: At 14:12:50 UTC, WS-ACOLE-01 recorded a Windows 4648 explicit-credentials event targeting svc-grades in ORCHARD on DC-ORC-01. The event names SYSTEM and C:\Program Files\Meridian\OpsAgent\ops-agent.exe as the subject and process.
The supplied evidence contains one in-scope authentication-related event; that event does not establish a failed domain logon or repeated failures.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection were unavailable on DC-ORC-01 and FILE-ORC-01 from 13:20 through 14:15 UTC, overlapping most of the review window and the alerted activity.
The provided records do not include the domain controller's authentication outcome for the event.
claims_not_established: Whether svc-grades authentication attempts failed repeatedly, succeeded, or both during the review window.
Whether the 14:12 event is related to the alert's reported failures or to the scheduled password rotation and GradeSync update.
Whether OpsAgent is authorized on WS-ACOLE-01, why it used svc-grades credentials, or whether the activity was malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-ORC-01 authentication records for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including failure and success events for svc-grades.
Obtain FILE-ORC-01 logs and GradeSync job history covering the password rotation and subsequent runs.
Review WS-ACOLE-01 process creation and endpoint records for OpsAgent, including its parent process, executable provenance, and any related activity.
Confirm the password rotation and manual GradeSync update were completed as scheduled, and identify who performed them.
